rows.sprk_description: Insights Engine Widgets r1 — matter-health-single playbook (first proven topic). Composes QueryDataverse-resolved Matter context + KPI Assessments + spaarke-insights-index Observations into a 7-dimension diagnostic narrative (composite-grade, trend, themes, inflection, critical-assessments, forward-risk, evidence-gap) via the Task 020 synthesis prompt. Evidence-sufficiency rule kpiAssessments.min=2 routes to DeclineToFindNode on insufficient assessment count. Persists the synthesized envelope to sprk_matter.sprk_performancesummary per FR-14 via the existing UpdateRecord node executor. Cache TTL is read from sprk_aitopicregistry.sprk_cachettlminutes (60 minutes default) per FR-21.
